# Penston Studio

> Penston Studio is the side-project home of George Penston, a Principal Product Designer at LinkedIn. A one-person practice in product design and development, building small, considered tools. Everything here is free.

## Projects
- [Markedly](https://penston.studio/markedly/): a free macOS app that converts documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, and images to Markdown. Everything stays on your Mac. Available on the Mac App Store.
- [Pour Over for Raindrop](https://penston.studio/pour-over/): a GitHub Action that brews a daily digest from your Raindrop read-later list and delivers it to your inbox. Open source.
